# 4 bed detached house for sale

> The property comprises a mixed-use property which provides a detached two storey period residence, detached single storey former filling station/ retail unit and a detached double bay garage. Internally the residence is laid out to provide a sitting room, kitchen cum dining room and utility room at ground floor level, and 4 no. bedrooms with family bathroom at first floor level.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 122 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Ballinasloe, New Inn
- Cena: 300 000 €
